title: Half-meter topobathymetric elevation model and elevation-area-volume tables for Bear Lake, Utah and Idaho, 2002-2018
summary: This official Bear Lake release includes a topobathymetric raster and elevation-area-volume relationships calculated at 0.01-meter intervals. Elevations are referenced to NAVD88.
citation: Root, J.C., Denny, J.F., Danforth, W.W., and Colman, S.M., 2026, Half-meter topobathymetric elevation model and elevation-area-volume tables for Bear Lake, Utah and Idaho, 2002-2018: U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P14KZS2D.
